pages.title: A map is a question
pages.text: Cartographers do not merely draw places. They decide which measurements deserve to survive the journey. Their chests may now contain a Field Manuscript: one bounded fragment selected from the current tradition pool.$(br2)The chance is finite, and an empty pool yields nothing. No reader's knowledge is consulted when a chest is filled.

pages.title: Four routes into proof
pages.text: The first pool carries four routes: the Rotated Horizon, the Bound Measure, the Ledger of Remainders, and Weighted Gathering. Each manuscript is a record, not a spell. Read it to learn what the world has remembered; build the proof yourself at the Programmer.$(br2)A Mathemagician may eventually exchange emeralds for these records, but the house and profession remain a later construction.
